title: Graph Valid Tree
description:
You are given `n` nodes labeled `0` to `n - 1` and a list of **undirected** edges, where `edges[i] = [a, b]` connects nodes `a` and `b`.

Return `true` if these edges form a **valid tree** (the graph is connected and contains no cycle), otherwise `false`.
constraints: There are no self-loops and no repeated edges.
hints: A tree on n nodes has exactly n - 1 edges. Check that first.
With the right edge count, the graph is a tree if and only if it is connected (or equivalently has no cycle). Union-find or a single traversal will tell you.
